bibliographic.title: Mitigating Hallucination in Large Language Models (LLMs): An Application-Oriented Survey on RAG, Reasoning, and Agentic Systems

relevance_to_mlgg: Distinguishes knowledge-based vs logic-based hallucination. RAG and reasoning strategies directly applicable to grounding extract_paper_metadata.py against PubMed/PMC sources.
key_findings: RAG effective against knowledge-based hallucination (wrong facts)
Reasoning enhancement effective against logic-based hallucination (wrong inference)
Agentic systems combine both for robust mitigation
actionable_for_mlgg: RAG: retrieve PMC full-text sections as grounding context (already partially implemented)
Reasoning: chain-of-thought prompting for leakage_risk assessment inference
Agentic verification: second-pass agent validates extracted values against source text
